notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: the story runs about 80 words because the sources reached give only the listing (type unknown, status gone, coordinates) and a forest name. Two searches and the cached Arizona lists turned up no build date, staffing, fire record or site description. Peakbagging's Arizona tables do not list a Washington Peak entry. A human check against Forest Service or Forest Fire Lookout Association records would help before this story is published.
